svg.aria-label: The interlock network on the world map
svg.title: The interlock network on the world map

g.text: The 3,910 firms the source can place, each at its own point, and the 43,164 ties among them — 9,025 of which never leave a single place and cannot be drawn at all on a map of cities. Disc area is proportional to the firms in it; position inside a disc means

nothing. Colour is precision, not geography: 1,896 of these firms have no address and sit at their filing country's anchor point, which is a fact about the catalogue. Discs overlap where two places are close, so a hairline ring marks the edge of each.
2,079 firms and their ties are not on this map. Plate carrée; no basemap ships with this repo, so the graticule carries the geography.
